headword: {進捗報告|しんちょくほうこく}

definitions.explanation: A report on the current state of progress of a project, task, or activity. Standard business and project management terminology.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧、{進捗報告|しんちょくほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We give a progress report once a week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{進捗報告|しんちょくほうこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I sent a progress report email to my boss.

examples.japanese: {進捗報告|しんちょくほうこく}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: According to the progress report, the project is on schedule.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ミーティング→ミーティング：05506_miitingu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{各自|かくじ}→各自：00157_kakuji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{進捗報告|しんちょくほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Each person gives a progress report at the morning meeting.

notes:
Essential business vocabulary in Japanese workplaces. Compound of 進捗 (progress, advancement) + 報告 (report). Regular progress reporting is a hallmark of Japanese corporate culture. Often abbreviated to 進捗 alone in casual workplace speech (進捗⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？ = How's the progress?).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {進捗報告|しんちょくほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to make a progress report
- {進捗報告|しんちょくほうこく}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧: progress report meeting
- {進捗報告|しんちょくほうこく}⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧: progress report email
- ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧{進捗報告|しんちょくほうこく}: regular progress report

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{経過報告|けいかほうこく}→経過報告：22899_keikahoukoku⟧: interim report — emphasizes the passage of time and developments
- ⟦{中間報告|ちゅうかんほうこく}→中間報告：16653_chuukanhoukoku⟧: mid-term report — report given at the halfway point
- {状況報告|じょうきょうほうこく}: situation report — focuses on current conditions rather than movement forward
